app.name: Vrtić Connect
app.placeholderNotice: This screen is a placeholder – business features are not implemented yet.

auth.loginIntro: Sign in with your kindergarten account.
auth.formInvalid: The form has errors. Check the highlighted fields.
auth.passwordRules: At least 12 characters; not your e-mail address and not a common password.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.invalid: The invitation link is invalid, expired or already used.
invite.intro: You are invited to "{{organization}}" with the role: {{role}}.
invite.registerIntro: Create an account to accept the invitation.
invite.namesRequired: Enter your given and family name.
invite.loginFirst: An account already exists for this address. Sign in, then accept the invitation.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is not for the account you are signed in with. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.

verify.title: E-mail confirmation
verify.invalid: The confirmation link is invalid, expired or already used.
verify.done: Your e-mail address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.intro: Confirm the e-mail address of your account.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail of your account. If the account exists, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with this address exists, a link to set a new password has been sent. The link is valid for 15 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.invalid: The password reset link is invalid, expired or already used.
reset.done: Your password was changed. All devices were signed out; sign in with the new password.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Enter the code the app shows now.
mfa.enrollIntro: Your role requires two-step verification. Set it up now; after that you can continue to the application.
mfa.appHint: You need an authenticator app on your phone, for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with the authenticator app.
mfa.manual: Cannot scan it? Add an account manually with this key (time based, 6 digits, 30 seconds):
mfa.copyFailed: Copying is not available; select the text and copy it manually.
mfa.confirmIntro: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish the setup (before {{time}}).
mfa.recoveryIntro: Store these codes in a safe place. If you lose your phone, each code can be used once instead of the app code. They are shown only now.
mfa.reauthIntro: For your security, enter your password again.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.keyNotCode: This is the setup key, not the code. Enter it in the authenticator app on your phone (or scan the QR code), then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.sixDigits: The code is exactly 6 digits from the app on your phone.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFoundDetail: The requested page does not exist or has moved.
errors.unexpectedDetail: Something went wrong. Refresh the page or try again later.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

ui.name: Name
ui.noAccess: You do not have access to this screen.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.notFound: The item does not exist or is not available to you.
errors.conflict: The item was changed meanwhile or conflicts with an existing one. Refresh and try again.
